text:
He should be found guilty of **aggravated battery (or assault with extreme indifference to human life)**. The only injury here was serious, not fatal, so the charge is not murder. Driving at high speed on a busy street while admitting indifference to the consequences shows a conscious disregard of a very high risk, which supplies the malice (depraved-heart) mental state without any intent to injure.

CONFIDENCE: 50
